set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Assessment: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: Q03.2
Accountable role (person unassigned): Institutional operator and service owner
Pilot scope: required

Scope: Show that a named team can sustain the service, not just install it once.
Work kind: institutional
Acceptance gate: Q03 (bd-01M4W40M7DJRQJWNCBEPR0AFEN)

Acceptance criteria:
1. Run the agreed staging observation period with representative authorized activity and at least one scheduled backup cycle, integrity check and operator incident/recovery exercise.
2. Verify real alert receipt, incident ownership, secret/credential rotation and support escalation with the people on the service roster.
3. Record monitoring/backup history, incidents and remediation; unowned alerts, unexplained data loss and unmet recovery objectives block pilot acceptance.

Verification: Observation-period log, alert/escalation acknowledgments and operator/service-owner acceptance.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/Q03.2/receipt.json
Evidence must include: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input.

External inputs (never assume supplied):
- Institutional support roster
- Agreed observation period

Starting code/evidence:
- docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md#5-what-qualification-must-prove

Blocked by:
- Q03.1: bd-01M4W5PCKCAJRRS1R41JSD6SS5
- Q02: bd-01M4W40M3Y7795AWYWHVAA9K68
- Q01: bd-01M4W40KZWFPTRA33A443C4DM8

Completion rule: satisfy every acceptance criterion with observed evidence. Failed or not-run requirements stay open. Preserve scientific identity/history and current authority; create blocking remediation work for discovered scope. Automated or simulated evidence cannot replace a required institutional or human result. No implementation is claimed by this plan.
